stemEn: A 2-year-old boy presented with coarse facial features, joint stiffness, and cloudy cornea. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Coarse facies + joint stiffness + corneal clouding هي مجموعة clues واضحة في المصدر لـHurler syndrome. وجود corneal clouding يساعد على التفريق عن Hunter syndrome.
reasoningEn: Corneal clouding with coarse facies and progressive joint stiffness supports Hurler syndrome rather than Hunter syndrome.
incorrectOptionsAr: Hunter syndrome قد يشبه Hurler لكنه عادةً لا يسبب corneal clouding.
clinicalPearl: Corneal clouding is a useful high-yield discriminator between Hurler and Hunter syndromes.

stemEn: A child who is known to have mucopolysaccharidosis type IV (MPS IV) presented with hypotonia and hyperreflexia of the upper limbs. What is the most likely cause of these new neurological symptoms?
explanationAr: في MPS IV يسبب odontoid dysplasia عدم ثبات C1-C2، وقد ينتج عنه atlantoaxial subluxation مع cervical cord compression وظهور weakness/hyperreflexia.
reasoningEn: Morquio syndrome can cause odontoid dysplasia and atlantoaxial instability, leading to cervical cord compression and new neurologic signs.
incorrectOptionsAr: Brain tumor ليس complication مميزة لهذا الاضطراب. Spondylolisthesis قد يحدث في skeletal disease لكنه لا يفسر نمط cervical cord findings المذكور مثل atlantoaxial instability.
clinicalPearl: New neurologic findings in Morquio syndrome should raise concern for cervical cord compression from atlantoaxial instability.
managementSteps: Urgent cervical spine/neurosurgical assessment when cord compression is suspected

stemEn: A child with developmental delay had a bone X-ray showing dysostosis multiplex. What test do you want to do next?
explanationAr: Dysostosis multiplex في المصدر يرفع الشك في mucopolysaccharidosis، والتشخيص النهائي يعتمد على enzyme activity assay مع molecular confirmation.
reasoningEn: Dysostosis multiplex suggests a mucopolysaccharidosis, for which enzyme activity testing is the definitive biochemical test in the source.
incorrectOptionsAr: Organic acids/amino acids وTMS ليست الاختبارات النهائية المناسبة لمجموعة MPS التي يشير إليها dysostosis multiplex.
clinicalPearl: Dysostosis multiplex is a radiographic clue to several mucopolysaccharidoses.
diagnosticSteps: Confirm with molecular testing as appropriate

stemEn: A slide was provided showing Gaucher cells on bone marrow. What is the definitive treatment?
explanationAr: المصدر يعامل الصورة كـGaucher disease ويختار Enzyme Replacement Therapy، خصوصًا في symptomatic non-neuronopathic Gaucher disease (type 1).
reasoningEn: The source identifies the bone-marrow slide as Gaucher disease and keys enzyme replacement therapy as definitive treatment for symptomatic non-neuronopathic disease.
incorrectOptionsAr: Chemotherapy ليست علاج Gaucher disease. BMT/HCT له دور محدود جدًا مقارنةً بـERT ولا يمثل الخيار القياسي لـGD1.
clinicalPearl: ERT is standard disease-specific therapy for symptomatic Gaucher type 1; neuronopathic Gaucher disease is different.

stemEn: A child presented with regression in developmental milestones. His family had a 3-year-old girl who died after the same presentation. Bone marrow aspiration showed Gaucher cells. How will you treat this child?
explanationAr: المصدر يضع A كمفتاح لكنه يوضح أن العبارة الأدق هي supportive care وليس حرفيًا 'no treatment'. الصورة السريرية تُفسَّر كـGaucher type 2، حيث ERT لا يوقف neurodegeneration القاتل.
reasoningEn: The source key is A, but its own explanation says the intended concept is supportive care for neuronopathic Gaucher type 2 rather than literally offering no treatment.
incorrectOptionsAr: Liver transplant ليس العلاج المناسب. BMT قد يُناقش في حالات مختارة مبكرًا لكنه ليس الجواب الذي اعتمده المصدر لهذه الصورة المتقدمة.
clinicalPearl: Do not equate 'no disease-modifying therapy' with no care; neuronopathic Gaucher disease still requires active supportive management.
managementSteps: Provide supportive neurologic and respiratory care

stemEn: A patient presented with hypotonia, exaggerated startle response, and a picture showing a cherry-red spot. What is the most likely diagnosis?
explanationAr: Hypotonia + exaggerated startle + cherry-red macula في infantile neurodegeneration هي clues المصدر لـTay-Sachs disease.
reasoningEn: The recalled clinical pattern and cherry-red macular finding support Tay-Sachs disease.
incorrectOptionsAr: بقية الخيارات غير محفوظة في المصدر، لذلك لم تُختلق.
clinicalPearl: A cherry-red spot is not unique to Tay-Sachs; the absence of hepatosplenomegaly helps distinguish it from some other lysosomal storage disorders.
diagnosticSteps: Measure hexosaminidase A activity and confirm genetically when appropriate

stemEn: An 8-month-old infant's mother came to your clinic with concerns about her baby's development. He is unable to turn over, sit, or crawl. On examination, he has hypotonia and an exaggerated startle response. Fundoscopic examination showed a cherry-red spot. Which statement is true regarding the most likely diagnosis?

options.text: Most of them will die at age of 5 years
Microcephaly will be noted in the future

explanationAr: الصورة السريرية هي infantile Tay-Sachs. المصدر يذكر progression شديدًا مع loss of milestones، وغالبًا الوفاة بعمر 4–5 سنوات؛ كما أن macrocephaly—not microcephaly—قد تُرى.
reasoningEn: The source describes classic infantile Tay-Sachs as a rapidly progressive neurodegenerative disease with death commonly by four to five years.
incorrectOptionsAr: المرض ليس مجرد variable developmental delay؛ هناك progressive loss of milestones. Microcephaly ليست الصفة المتوقعة، والمصدر يذكر أن macrocephaly شائعة.
clinicalPearl: Infantile Tay-Sachs is due to HEXA/hexosaminidase A deficiency and causes progressive neurodegeneration without visceral organomegaly.
